title: [UE-0.6] Smoke hook
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Gameplay Dev

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Dev Lead

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Smoke/**`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Smoke/**`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.3, UE-0.8

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.6b, UE-0.6c, UE-0.6d, UE-0.12, UE-0.21

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `-SmokeQuitAfter=15` on a Development package logs one `SMOKE_OK map=L_Graybox fps=N worst_ms=N commit=SHA input=ok input_vz=N res=WxH win=W textpx=N load_ms=N workbench=0` line per the contract in `tools/ue_run.py` and quits with exit code 0. W is windowed or fullscreen. input=ok means it held `IA_Attack` through Enhanced Input and saw ATTACK_DESCENT and Z velocity < 0 within 0.5 s, logged as `input_vz=N` (cm/s) (GDD 1.3: with nothing held the umbrella rises, so only descent proves input); until MVP 2 merges (its QA-01 test-map row reads merged), run with SMOKE_REQUIRE_INPUT=0 and paste that setting: `check_pr.py` then accepts input=none
- [ ] At the first gameplay frame it logs one `SMOKE_EFFECTIVE commit=SHA workbench=0 platform=Windows manifest=V KEY=VALUE ...` line per the contract in `tools/ue_run.py` (final-9 B C1): every `// bake:` key read from the running objects (`IsFeatureEnabled` on the live harness subsystem, the tuning struct the spawned components hold), never from a header or BUILD_INFO. commit= and workbench= are compiled in (`UMBRELLAELLA_BUILD_COMMIT`, stamped by the package script at build start; `pipeline/unreal-rules.md` Smoke hook); `bake_preset.py effective` in the smoke output prints PASS (pasted)
- [ ] It supports `-SmokeMap=/Game/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_Graybox` (that map loads instead of GameDefaultMap), pasted
- [ ] `tools\ue\smoke.ps1` prints PASS on a real Development package (pasted); it found `BUILD_INFO.txt`, and the `-abslog` game log file exists (paste `ls`)
- [ ] A `-SmokeCrash` switch (non-Shipping only) crashes on purpose: `SMOKE_FORCE_CRASH=1 tools\ue\smoke.ps1 -Exe EXE` FAILS with a new crash folder (pasted)
- [ ] `tools\ue\daily.ps1` prints a DAILY line with build, test, package and smoke PASS on a real Development package, run with SMOKE_MIN_TEXT_PX=0 until the first UI card merges (pasted). Display and verify-tags are card 0.6d. No Shipping smoke (D-new-smoke). Whether 0.6 blocks other gameplay cards is D-new-06-block

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
